items.item: A stepper names each step and lets the user go back to earlier steps
items.evidence: renderStepper() with STEPS = ['Tải file lên','Ghép cột','Xem trước & kiểm tra','Nhập dữ liệu'] and aria-current. Going back is done by buttons #back ('Chọn file khác') and #backMap ('Quay lại ghép cột'); the stepper items themselves are not clickable and step 3 cannot jump straight to step 1.

items.item: Column mapping auto-matches headers and marks required target fields
items.evidence: autoMap() matches normalised headers against FIELDS[].aliases, with a fuzzy fallback and an 'Tự động ghép lại' button. Required fields get a red '*' (title 'Bắt buộc'), a red border on an empty select, a 'Thiếu' status, and a banner 'Chưa ghép trường bắt buộc'. #toPreview is disabled while any is missing.

items.item: The preview table shows per-row errors and an error count, and offers to download the failing rows
items.evidence: viewPreview(): a 'Lỗi (không thể nhập)' count tile and filter tab, a per-row status plus an inline issue list ('Lỗi · SKU: Trùng SKU trong file'), and red-highlighted cells. #dlErr 'Tải danh sách lỗi (.csv)' exports row number, SKU, severity, field and message, not the raw failing rows, and it includes warnings.

items.item: The import shows progress, can continue in the background, and ends with a summary of created, updated and failed rows
items.evidence: Progress: viewImport() has a role=progressbar with a percentage. Background: none; the text says 'Vui lòng không đóng trang này.' and there is no background or notify option. Summary: shows Thêm mới (created), Cập nhật (updated) and Bỏ qua (skipped) plus stock totals, but no 'failed' count; failed rows are folded into 'skipped'.

items.item: The flow runs on a page or a full-width panel, not inside a small modal
items.evidence: The flow is a full page: header with breadcrumb, <main class='max-w-6xl'>, and sections in a grid. No modal or dialog element exists. Only the undo uses confirm().

items.item: A template file is offered for download before upload
items.evidence: Step 1 has #dlTemplate 'Tải mẫu CSV chuẩn', which calls download('mau-nhap-san-pham.csv', ...). It sits beside the dropzone and is visible in the first-viewport screenshot.

notes: Audit score 80/100 (text-contrast x5, radius-scale: the 12px rounded-xl cards). Otherwise little template styling: no gradient, glass, emoji icons, greeting header, KPI icon tiles or decorative chart. The preview summary tiles are plain numbers, and the result tiles are mild card-in-card inside the summary card. Status colours (green, amber, red, blue) carry real validation meaning. Table headers are uppercase without tracking. The 'Nhập gần đây' list and the disabled stepper circles have low contrast. Table rows are inline-editable inputs with cell highlighting.
